weakness: Shared desk SCADA login; no account procedure, approvals, reviews, or monitoring; departed technician's SCADA account active 5 months
source: P07 (AC-02 objectives); P01 R-006; P03 G-031
remediation_plan: Named desk accounts; written SCADA account procedure; last-day checklist with SCADA first; monthly user review by the Owner
milestones: 2026-07-23 departed account disabled and shared password changed; 2026-09-30 last-day checklist in use; 2026-10-31 shared login removed and first monthly review
resources_required: Operations Manager and Owner time (1 hour a month)

weakness: SCADA administrator account (and every controller account) signs in with a password only
remediation_plan: Enable the vendor's app-based MFA on every SCADA account; sealed break-glass credential in the office safe; tested fallback so MFA never blocks a safety action
milestones: 2026-09-30 MFA enabled for the administrator; 2026-10-31 all accounts and break-glass procedure tested
resources_required: Included in the SCADA subscription; 4 hours of staff time

weakness: Command rights usable from any network with a password; no remote access rules; browser-saved passwords on 2 laptops
remediation_plan: Remote access rules (POL-02 B.6, B.7); remove saved passwords; vendor sign-in alerts to the Owner and Operations Manager; command rights limited to company-managed devices
milestones: 2026-08-19 saved passwords removed; 2026-10-01 POL-02 effective; 2026-10-31 sign-in alerts on

weakness: Gas control desk on the flat office network; a gateway reachable from the internet; no boundary monitoring
remediation_plan: Check all 7 SIMs against the carrier's private-network list; separate firewall segment and dedicated desk workstations; EDR alerting
milestones: 2026-08-19 exposed SIM moved to the private network; 2026-09-30 remaining 6 SIMs confirmed; 2026-11-30 desk segment and workstations live; 2026-12-31 EDR alerting
resources_required: About $3,200 one-time (desk rebuild); EDR about $1,300 a year

weakness: Default password on one gateway; no password rules; shared password not refreshed; saved passwords in browsers
remediation_plan: Unique passwords on every gateway, RTU, flow computer, and network device, recorded on a sealed list; password rules in POL-02 B.8 and C.3
milestones: 2026-08-19 gate station gateway password changed; 2026-10-31 all field devices checked and changed

weakness: No PSGCS inventory; firmware, gateways, and SIMs not recorded; May 2026 SIM change not recorded
remediation_plan: One-page PSGCS inventory with firmware versions and SIM status; update on every change (POL-04 4.4)

weakness: No company copy of SCADA configuration; RTU programs on one laptop; suite backup not immutable
source: P07 (CP-09 objectives); P01 R-009, R-016; P04 finding 5
remediation_plan: Quarterly SCADA configuration export and RTU program copies on encrypted media in the safe; suite backup upgraded to 90-day immutable versions
milestones: 2026-10-31 first export and copies; 2026-10-31 backup upgraded
resources_required: About $500 a year; encrypted media about $100

weakness: No restore test; no exercise of gas control desk loss or a SCADA vendor outage
remediation_plan: First suite restore test; quarterly restore tests; tabletop covering desk loss and vendor outage with the manual operation call list

weakness: No approved incident response plan at fieldwork; no shut-in criteria in the emergency plan
source: P07 (IR-08 objectives); P01 R-005; P03 G-019, G-030
remediation_plan: P08 runbook approved; cyber annex to the emergency plan with the decision table; printed copies at 4 locations; annual tabletop
milestones: 2026-09-15 runbook approved; 2026-10-15 printed copies distributed; 2026-11-30 cyber annex and first tabletop
resources_required: Staff time; insurer panel at no cost until used

weakness: SCADA audit log and suite sign-in logs never reviewed
remediation_plan: Monthly 30-minute review by the Owner (SCADA users, sign-ins, commands) and the Office Manager (suite sign-ins), recorded on a checklist
resources_required: Owner and Office Manager time (1 hour a month)

weakness: No security terms in the SCADA vendor, MSP, or carrier contracts; no ongoing supplier monitoring
remediation_plan: Security addendum (24-hour incident notice, support-session and change notice, data return); annual SOC 2 review and MSP questionnaire
milestones: 2026-09-04 SCADA vendor SOC 2 reviewed (P09); 2026-12-31 addendums signed and MSP questionnaire returned

weakness: No security awareness training or phishing exercises
remediation_plan: Annual online training; quarterly phishing simulations; reporting card at each desk and in each truck
milestones: 2026-10-31 reporting cards and first training; 2026-12-31 first simulation

weakness: Vendor support sessions not approved, monitored, or recorded by the company
remediation_plan: Support-session notice in the SCADA addendum; Operations Manager logs each notice and checks the tenant history afterwards
milestones: 2026-12-31 addendum signed; notice log in use
